Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Food | National Nutrifoods Ghana named confectionery company of the year at 6th Chamber Business Awards 24 November 2026 7:11pm Nutrifoods Ghana named Confectionery Company of the Year at 6th Chamber Business Awards ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Nutrifoods Ghana Limited, a leading manufacturer of snacks and culinary products in Ghana’s fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector, has been named Confectionery Company of the Year at the 6th Ghana National Chamber of Commerce and Industry (GNCCI) Chamber Business Awards, in recognition of its commitment to manufacturing excellence, innovation, product quality and contribution to Ghana’s industrial development.
The recognition underscores Nutrifoods Ghana’s continued dedication to delivering quality products that meet consumers’ everyday needs while contributing to the growth and competitiveness of Ghana’s manufacturing industry.
Organised by the Ghana National Chamber of Commerce and Industry, the Chamber Business Awards is one of the country’s prominent business recognition platforms, celebrating outstanding companies and individuals whose performance, leadership and innovation continue to shape Ghana’s business landscape. This year’s ceremony was held under the theme, “Shaping a Resilient Future: The Role of Sustainability and AI in Business”, bringing together key players from across the private sector to celebrate excellence and spotlight opportunities for sustainable economic growth.
As a member of the GNCCI, Nutrifoods Ghana continues to engage with a platform that champions private sector development, advocates business-friendly policies and promotes an enabling environment for enterprises to thrive. Through its engagement with government, industry stakeholders and development partners, the Chamber plays an important role in advancing the interests of businesses and strengthening Ghana’s economic ecosystem.
Reacting to the recognition, Mr Jay Anjaria, Business and Country Head of Nutrifoods Ghana Limited, expressed gratitude to the company’s employees, customers, distributors, suppliers and business partners, acknowledging their invaluable contributions to the company’s success.
“This award is a testament to our unwavering commitment to delivering quality products that meet the everyday snacking needs of Ghanaians. It reflects the dedication of our people and the trust our consumers place in our brands. We remain focused on investing in innovation, strengthening our capabilities and creating greater value for consumers every day,” he said.
The awards ceremony took place on Saturday, November 21, 2026, at the Labadi Beach Hotel in Accra, with Her Excellency Professor Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang, Vice-President of the Republic of Ghana, as Special Guest of Honour. In her remarks, she underscored the critical role of a strong and competitive private sector in accelerating economic growth, creating jobs and expanding opportunities for Ghanaians.
She also highlighted government initiatives, including the New Economy: New Ghana, Jobs and Prosperity Programme (2027–2030), aimed at addressing structural challenges confronting the private sector and unlocking new pathways for economic growth and prosperity.
The award further reinforces Nutrifoods Ghana Limited’s position within Ghana’s confectionery manufacturing industry and its commitment to building trusted brands, delivering products consumers love and creating moments of joy in homes and communities across the country.
